title: Astragenie plugin registry — skills manifest
description: One entry per skill discovered under a producer plugin's skills/**/SKILL.md, generated by @astragenie/plugin-registry (FEAT-009 SLICE-1). Committed here so the generator can validate every batch against it before writing registry/<plugin>/skills.json to disk.

name.description: Skill name from frontmatter. Pattern also acts as defense-in-depth against path traversal / shell metacharacters (AC-5) alongside the generator's dedicated E_REGISTRY_UNSAFE_NAME check.

sourcePlugin.description: The producer plugin this entry was generated from. Pattern mirrors "name" as defense-in-depth against path traversal / shell metacharacters (AC-5) alongside the generator's dedicated E_REGISTRY_UNSAFE_NAME check on --plugin.

version.description: Opaque semver-shaped string — the producer plugin's own version at generation time (not gated to a specific source field; see FEAT-009 ADR risk section).

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of generation. Logged for human debugging; NOT the staleness gate (see FEAT-009 ADR — staleness is a semver comparison, SLICE-3).
